description: Conditionally includes the host element in rendered output.
valueType: JavaScript expression evaluated against render state
behavior: The directive attribute is removed during template transformation.
The element is wrapped in an if block.
Falsy values omit the element from the rendered HTML.
Throwing expressions are caught by safe() and behave as falsy.
antiPatterns: Performing side effects in the expression.
Using it to hide large static sections that never change.
runtimeNotes: Runs during render, not as an isolated observer.
performanceNotes: Cheap for small sections; split large dynamic areas into child components.

description: Repeats the host element for each key in an object or array-like state value.
behavior: The directive attribute is removed during template transformation.
Each iteration exposes the item variable, $index, and $key.
Loop scope is stored internally and can flow to child components.
Iteration uses for...in over the evaluated object.
antiPatterns: Depending on iteration order for non-array objects.
Using generated scope ids as stable keys.
runtimeNotes: The runtime creates a transient scope object per iteration.
performanceNotes: Prefer smaller child components for expensive list rows.

description: Replaces the host element inner HTML with an evaluated expression.
valueType: JavaScript expression evaluated against render state
behavior: The directive attribute is removed during template transformation.
The original inner HTML becomes a progressive fallback.
Rendered value is inserted into element content.
antiPatterns: Using it when plain mustache text is enough and no fallback is needed.
runtimeNotes: Equivalent to putting an expression inside the element body after compilation.
performanceNotes: Prefer scalar strings or trusted markup.

description: Appends a computed class string to the existing class attribute.
behavior: Existing class text is preserved.
The expression output is appended to the class attribute.
Falsy or failing expressions produce an empty string.
antiPatterns: Returning arrays or objects without converting to a string.
Duplicating base classes in the expression.
runtimeNotes: Special-cased before generic html-* attribute transformation.

description: Defines instance initial state on a component element.
behavior: Parsed with new Function during component construction.
Overrides exported model keys.
Available to functional model as initialState.

description: Prevents Jails morphing from changing a node and its descendants.
behavior: When morphing reaches the node, Jails returns false from beforeNodeMorphed.
The existing DOM subtree remains intact.
State changes do not update content below this node.
antiPatterns: Using it to hide rendering bugs.
performanceNotes: Useful for reducing morph cost around third-party DOM.

description: Binds any normal HTML attribute from a JavaScript expression and strips the html- prefix.
behavior: The rendered attribute name is the text after html-.
Values are evaluated against render state.
Boolean attributes have special handling for native boolean names.
html-model and html-scopeid are reserved and not transformed as generic attributes.
antiPatterns: Using html-onclick instead of delegated events.
runtimeNotes: Expressions may omit outer braces: html-src="imageUrl".
performanceNotes: Avoid expensive computations in attribute expressions.

description: Uses the native template element to hide dynamic markup before Jails compiles it.
behavior: Template content is transformed recursively.
Plain templates are unwrapped during compilation.
Templates that carry html-if or html-inner are preserved for directive behavior.
antiPatterns: Wrapping all markup in template when SSR fallback is desired.
runtimeNotes: The browser does not render template contents before JavaScript.
